name: smwmusic-boards-of-canada-diving-station
title: Boards of Canada - Diving Station
description:
Another ear-transcribed port of mine. The overall ambience is loyal to original, although performed with a different set of instruments/SFX, I found the noises from Chrono Trigger to be very fitting here.

The duration is shortened a bit as to not insist on the non-melody aspects of the song.

It is probably best fit for overworlds and cutscenes, but can also work in levels that have a timer shorter than the song... Which isn't really a problem either since I gave a loop after a short silence.

It has been showcase at C3 Winter 2022.
